skills.name: agentic-skill-template
skills.description: Working template for Claude Code Agent Skills — exercises deterministic JSON envelope, dual-channel exit contract, anchor-term routing, single orchestrator agent, three test gates, and 2026 runtime surfaces. Adapt by renaming and replacing scripts with your domain logic.

agents.name: agentic-engineer
agents.description: Orchestrator template — routes user signals into deterministic envelope-returning scripts under skills/agentic-skill-template/scripts/. Parses the JSON envelope; respects the dual-channel contract (stdout exit 0 = success or retriable; stderr exit 1 = fatal config). Defaults write-path calls to --dry-run and masks tokens in all error paths.
